title: Where a help request goes

nodes.label: Sent to whom?
nodes.state: The Send to checkboxes in the dialog
nodes.note: The dialog pre-checks the nearest desk; the user can change it. A desk and people make two conversations, and each extra desk checked gets its own ticket

nodes.label: Project help desk configured?
nodes.state: helpdesk.json in the project root or a dependency, or the project is itself a desk portal

nodes.label: User added a help desk?
nodes.state: The user's own desk list on the hub

nodes.label: Hub has Flowpad support?
nodes.note: Offline, the last one seen is used

nodes.label: Stays private
nodes.note: Report it later turns a private request into a ticket

nodes.label: Task and conversation to the person
Ticket to the project's help desk
Ticket to the user's help desk

notes: Every request is saved on this computer first. Signed out or offline, it is sent on sign-in or reconnect
The diagnosis runs in the background and arrives as its own message
